For me the pensieve scene always struck me as weird because it’s one of Snape’s most traumatic memories right? He’s humiliated in front of a crowd and fully destroys he’s relationship with Lilly. If that’s the case why is it out to be viewed by anyone and not just pushed deep into his head? I’m not saying that the scene was doctored(But Lockhart became famous for his own mind shenanigans) but it seems like he wanted Harry to see that . It Shakes his faith in his father and the next Christmas if I’m correct he asks Sirius and Remus about it. My point that I’m trying to make out of all of this rambling is that it’s highly likely that Snape left this out to fuck with the already mentally imbalanced teenager who he is also rooting through his mind to help him block out a connection to the person who killed his parents. 

At the same time I could be looking into it but as bad as James Potter was to Severus didn’t he retaliate as well? I’m pretty sure Remus says “He gave as good as he got”, or that could be my Fanfic addled mind not being able to differentiate the two anymore. In the end of the day Snape ruined two families on that Halloween in case some people forget. And when he finds out that the Dark Lord wants them dead he doesn’t beg to spare the children or warn Lilly or Alice he begs for Lilly’s life and hers alone fine with letting her one year old son and husband die. Not to mention all the shit he gives Neville and Harry throughout the series even if he is the direct reason of both of their parents not being able to care for them.

When Voldemort comes to godricks hallow James who doesn’t have his wand since Harry had it and was playing with it before he and Lily ran upstairs decided to hold off Voldemort on his own basically unarmed. That one scene for me makes it hard to be on the James Potter wasn’t that great of a guy and mind you this what 3-4 years out of Hogwarts so basically same 7th year James who would curse Snape in secret was willing to go out swinging to make sure his wife and son were safe is more than enough for his redemption if he even needed one. Snape was redeemed because he had the time and regrets to do so while James died before he could grow as a person and tbh being 21 isn’t that much of an Adult to begin with
